# Command-line reference

`spaceman` runs the control plane (`serve`), its offline administration (`admin`, `keys`, `backup`) and a remote client
for the administrative API. The remote commands are described in [the CLI guide](../../operators/cli); this reference is
generated from the command definitions, so it always matches the binary. Every remote command names the
[API operations](../api) it calls.

## Global flags

Every command accepts these.

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--allow-insecure-http` | bool |  | allow plain http to a non-loopback server (the token crosses the network in clear text; env SPACEMAN_ALLOW_INSECURE_HTTP=1) |
| `-c`, `--config` | string |  | configuration file of serve and the offline commands (env SPACEMAN_CONFIG) |
| `-o`, `--output` | string |  | output format: table, json or yaml (env SPACEMAN_OUTPUT; default table) |
| `--server` | string |  | central URL, e.g. https://spaceman.example.com (env SPACEMAN_SERVER) |
| `--timeout` | duration | `1m0s` | timeout of one HTTP request |
| `--token-file` | string |  | file holding the API token (env SPACEMAN_TOKEN_FILE; or put the token itself in SPACEMAN_TOKEN) |

## Exit codes

| Code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `0` | success |
| `1` | usage: bad flags or arguments, unreadable input files, local failures |
| `2` | API error (other statuses, an unwanted final state such as a failed relocation or a broken audit chain) or the server could not be reached |
| `3` | conflict: 409, 412 or 428 (the object changed since it was read, already exists, or the operation's precondition failed) |
| `4` | not found: 404 (also a space you cannot read) |
| `5` | authentication or authorization: 401, 403, or no usable token |

|---|---|

| [`spaceman approval-policy`](./approval-policy) | Operations that need a person's approval |
| [`spaceman audit`](./audit) | The audit log: list and verify the hash chain |
| [`spaceman backup`](./backup) | Create, list, verify and restore sealed backups (docs: site/operators/backup.md) |

| [`spaceman event`](./event) | Events: Pulse connections, templates and subscriptions |
| [`spaceman human`](./human) | Human actions: list, show, respond and cancel |

| [`spaceman keys`](./keys) | Key-encryption key management |

| [`spaceman mcp`](./mcp) | Central MCP gateway: servers and grants |
| [`spaceman node`](./node) | Nodes: list, enroll, disable, enable and revoke |
| [`spaceman openapi`](./openapi) | Print the OpenAPI 3.1 document of the API |
| [`spaceman profile`](./profile) | Harness profiles: list, show, create and update |
| [`spaceman prompt`](./prompt) | Prompt catalog: list, show, create, save a draft and publish |
| [`spaceman role`](./role) | Roles of a space (--space) and role templates |
| [`spaceman run`](./run) | Runs: list, show, launch and stop (--space) |
| [`spaceman schedule`](./schedule) | A space's schedules: list, show, create, update and delete (--space) |
| [`spaceman serve`](./serve) | Run the control plane (API, web UI, node connections, management listener) |
| [`spaceman skill`](./skill) | Skill catalog: list, show and publish |
| [`spaceman space`](./space) | Spaces: create, edit, pause, archive, purge and relocate |
